title: Light chicken Caesar salad with yoghurt dressing
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper, fry it in 1 tsp oil for 5–6 minutes per side and slice it.
Dice the bread and toast it in the remaining oil until crisp.
Stir the yoghurt with lemon juice, crushed garlic, mustard, half the Parmesan, salt and pepper.
Tear the lettuce, toss it with the dressing, top with the chicken and croutons and sprinkle with the rest of the Parmesan.
